workspace.description: What the ids were minted from. Exactly one of `module_path` and `modules` is present: a tree of one module has a module path, and a `go.work` has a list of them and no single answer -- which is the same reason a workspace run publishes a workspace report rather than a run report. See ADR 0012.

modules.description: The workspace's modules in `use` order, for a listing of a `go.work`.

dir.description: The module root relative to the workspace root, slash-separated, and "." for a workspace that uses its own root.

module_path.description: The module `path` is relative to, present only in a listing of a workspace. Two modules of one workspace can each hold an `app.go`, and the path alone would not say which.

termination.description: Present only when go-mutants could prove, before executing anything, whether this mutant's loop still stops. verdict is `bounded` when the edit leaves a decreasing measure and `unbounded` when it removes one -- meaning there is an input for which the mutant does not terminate, which a run will report as a timeout. It never changes a verdict: a mutant proved unbounded is catalogued, instrumented and measured like any other, and this says what its timeout will mean rather than whether to have one. Absent is the common case and is never a claim that a loop is fine: only the counted loop is recognised, and a range, a loop with no condition, or one whose body moves its own bound is refused silently. loop_line and loop_column address the `for` keyword, as 1-based lines and 1-based byte columns of the pristine file.

reason.description: One line naming the edit's effect on the measure, for a reader who wants to know why before believing it.

branch.description: Present only when go-mutants proved this edit can only narrow the condition of an if or a for. body_start is the body's opening brace and body_end its closing brace, as 1-based lines and 1-based byte columns of the pristine file — the coordinates `go test -coverprofile` reports statement blocks in. A test during which no statement of that body executed cannot distinguish the mutant from the original program. direction names the lemma the span came from and is diagnostic; the promise is about the span alone, so a consumer must not branch on it.
